subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Climate Governance Pressure
description: A short lesson to help you apply Climate Governance Pressure.

hook.text: Shareholders filed climate resolutions at 100+ companies in 2023. Boards can't ignore the planet anymore.

buildup.text: Climate governance requires boards to oversee emissions targets, transition plans, and physical climate risks.

discovery.text: A Dutch court ordered Shell to cut emissions 45% by 2030. Directors face personal liability for climate inaction.

twist.text: Engine No. 1, a tiny fund, won three ExxonMobil board seats by running on a climate platform.

climax.text: Climate has moved from activism to governance. Boards that ignore it face legal, financial, and reputational risk.

punchline.text: A tiny fund won Exxon board seats. Climate is governance now.

quiz.question: What did Engine No. 1 achieve at ExxonMobil?
options: Won three board seats on a climate platform
